tagline: AI-Powered Local Governance for Every Filipino
aboutText: The Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo is the legislative body of the Municipality of Pitogo, Province of Quezon. Headed by the Vice Mayor as Presiding Officer, the Sanggunian is composed of eight elected councilors, two ex-officio members, and the SB Secretary. The council enacts ordinances, approves resolutions, and exercises legislative authority to promote the general welfare and development of the municipality and its 39 barangays.
